items.subject: A fan-shaped ivory clam shell with coral-pink ribs and a small teal striker bead attached at its bottom. Closed front silhouette, no animal face. It is a musical shell switch, not a pearl treasure.
A golden brass ship departure bell, front view, small suspension loop at top, broad flared lip and visible clapper at bottom. No support pole.

A friendly heart SYMBOL made of polished warm gold, two rounded lobes and a pointed bottom, thick navy outline, cream highlight and three small contained gleam marks. Clearly distinct from a coral-red healing heart. No anatomy.
A large golden coral gate key, diagonally from upper left to lower right, circular bow handle, solid shaft and two broad teeth. Clearly readable key silhouette.
One orange and warm-gold sleeveless life jacket, two buoyant front panels with a teal belt and simple navy buckle. Empty jacket, no body, face, arms or text.
One neatly coiled thick cream maritime rescue rope with a short tied tail. Broad simple loop shape, visible twist shading, no hands or anchor.
One round orange and cream life ring with four broad cream sections and a dark teal center opening. Small integral rope attachments, no ocean or people.

One safe fantasy lightning protection device: upright teal-metal mast, horizontal upper crossbar, sturdy small flat base, central golden lightning bolt emblem. Not an electrical hazard, no lightning arcs outside object.
One short wooden ship mast with a slightly bent spar, thick rope bindings and one mild structural crack, warm honey wood and teal metal fittings. No people, splinters flying or dangerous damage.
One small upright arch gate in coral-pink stone, navy opening with two teal bars and a centered gold diamond lock. Whole arch and footings inside canvas.
One upright intertwined green vine with four broad friendly rounded leaves, forming a loose S shape. Thick readable stems, no thorns or flowers.
One upright short wooden torch, cloth wrapping at top and a contained warm orange flame with cream inner core. Entire flame and handle inside canvas, no sparks outside.
One friendly squat stone fantasy furnace, navy-purple body, wide rectangular fire opening, gold-bronze upper rim and small warm orange contained inner flame. No chimney smoke.
One upright hanging cream maritime rope with a large loop knot at its lower end, clear three horizontal twist bands. Entire rope and loop inside canvas.

One upright hexagonal pale-blue crystal mirror with a lavender-and-gold frame and one simple UP ARROW symbol engraved in cream at its center. Arrow only, no letters or numbers. Preserve clear arrow direction for rotation puzzle.
One closed upright cream-and-brown travel journal, navy binding, blank cover, small teal bookmark ribbon. Simple raised bands rather than writing, no letters or readable marks.
One unfolded upright cream and lavender travel map with two fold lines, a large golden five-point star and a simple teal triangle route. Symbols only, no labels, letters, coordinates or numbers.
One upright friendly teal and brass lantern with a small loop handle, warm gold glass panes and a cream inner flame. Short broad foot, no light rays or glow outside silhouette.

One upright small fantasy compass puzzle device on a gold pedestal: navy circular dial inside lavender rim, large four-point gold compass star with teal center gem. No letters, numerals or tick labels.
One sturdy honey-brown wooden delivery crate with diagonal reinforcing planks and broad brass bands, simple gold diamond plate without text. Subtle top and right side, no tools or contents outside.
One teal square reward gift box with gold ribbon, coral-red bow on top, thick navy outline. No letters, tags or additional gifts.

One small friendly fantasy treasure pedestal with navy stone stepped base, gold trim and a large teal diamond-shaped crystal floating immediately above it. Simple cream center glow contained inside crystal, no deity or person.
One small faceted lavender moon rock with broad cream fracture seams and a small gold four-point sparkle engraved on its face. Stable whole rock, no fragments flying, no face.
One peaceful original decorative lotus pedestal: a large rounded pink lotus blossom on a low gold stone base, tiny teal center. Pure floral decoration, no person, deity or religious figure.
One celebratory gold bell on a short upright gold stand, coral clapper, cream engraved wave band. Three small gold gleams stay within canvas. No people, letters or confetti outside.
